answer: Proof of Personhood serves as a pearl of security in multi-agent networks, requiring agents to undergo biometrically verified uniqueness checks. Like a lantern illuminating hidden actors, this mechanism forces an attacker to acquire expensive, verified human credentials for each identity. By anchoring the lotus of trust to physical existence, the cost of a Sybil attack scales linearly with human labor, rendering the mass generation of fake autonomous nodes economically prohibitive.
